description: It reads one webinar as the full export that the dashboard produces: every field of the campaign, the page content, the mails and the settings, as one JSON text. Take it when a host wants to move a webinar to another site or keep a copy of the settings. "I am building this on my second site." The text is long, often tens of thousands of characters, so it stops at 20000 and says when it was cut. The complete file is the Export button in the dashboard. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: export webinar, backup, move to another site, JSON

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
